messages.content: How do I report a lost card?

response:
To report a lost or stolen card, you can follow these steps:

1. Contact AtlasBank immediately by calling our 24/7 Customer Service hotline at the number provided on your bank statement or on the back of your card.
2. Have your account number and other personal identification details ready when you call.
3. The customer service representative will assist you in canceling your lost or stolen card and issuing a new one.
4. If you have any pending transactions, the representative will help you manage them.
5. Keep your new card and any related information secure to prevent unauthorized use.
